My dear [Christabel](/person/329)
I should like of all things to have the dear Fernando, but alas! I don’t see a scrap of room for him before Christmas[^2] Orina will last till the summer Our Young ladies till Christmas, [Magnum Bonum](/book/131) 2 years - (I fear) Then [Miss R N Carey](/person/254) begins a long story in July, and I can't see a chink to put any thing in till Our Young Ladies are done, & I suppose you cannot wait.

yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^2]: Coleridge\'s novel The Constant Prince was about Prince Fernando of Portugal (1402-1443) and was eventually serialized in MP (January-June 1878. The other fictions which were in its way were Harriet Romanoff, \'Orina\', Euphemia Bussell, \'Our Young Ladies\', CMY\'s own Magnum Bonum and Rosa Nouchette Carey, Heriot\'s Choice.
